items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Jack Mayhew and Will Alger. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah that band.

ctx.x: Well, some and I had places I went steady like Cleveland - maybe I did Cleveland two times a year; each time I went I took a different band; once I went with an organized band thinking that's the way to go. I got the Salt City Six together in '71 to go in there with me and it was a very successful deal because their band-- I wasn't responsible for their withholdings because I actually put myself with them.
Yeah, Jack Mayhew and Will Alger.

Yeah that band. A very nice band and there's an example of one of the places now -- in Toronto everytime I went to Toronto, I had a different band; everytime I went to Toronto, I had a different band. It was never the same; sometimes on the trombone I'd have Marshall Brown; then someone else - and the next time, somebody else because it was an impossibility to keep a steady band together.
